title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Tempered Glass Solid Brass Hardware For Bathroom Storage | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom with a wall mount glass shelf designed to keep essentials off the counter in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This triple-tier glass shelf / vanity shelf combines 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware for everyday strength in modern bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass hardware supports the shelf system
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, contemporary look
- Multiple designer finish options available to coordinate with modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall dimensions: 16 inches (L) x 5 inches (W) x 15 inches (H)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
